description: International Packaging Films Limited (IPAK) is a Pakistani manufacturer of packaging films, founded in 2017 as a greenfield project to produce BOPP films at Raiwind, Lahore, and headquartered in Karachi. It makes transparent, metallized, white, cavitated and matte BOPP films and exports to a number of countries. The group has since added subsidiaries for cast polypropylene films (CPAK) and BOPET films (PETPAK), and an export arm, IPAK Connect, based in Dubai.

products.name: Transparent BOPP films
products.summary: High-transparency, high-gloss films with low SIT and a wide seal range, used mainly for printing and lamination.

products.name: Metallized films
products.summary: Used in lamination for single- and two-ply packaging structures for snacks, biscuits, confectionery and bakery products.

products.name: White films
products.summary: High-gloss, milky-white films used for biscuit, confectionery, chocolate and ice-cream packaging.

products.name: Cavitated / pearlized films
products.summary: Low-density, high-yield films giving improved aesthetics and a light barrier at lower material cost.

products.name: Matte films
products.summary: High-haze films that reduce light reflection, used for printing, web lamination and paper/board lamination.
